content: {"summary":"Customers feel the ban system is overly punitive and opaque, citing random suspensions for minor infractions such as swearing or profile changes [tk_567019, tk_447529]. Many report difficulty accessing case reviews, even when suspensions appear inactive on enforcement sites [tk_2742078, tk_2858541]. Users also express frustration over perceived unfair targeting, claiming they are banned without clear evidence or prior reports [tk_2499866, tk_2927789]. The overall sentiment is that the reputation and enforcement mechanisms lack transparency and fail to address legitimate user concerns [tk_2703758, tk_119924]."}
